title: anthyllis vulneraria var. dillenii
intro: Anthyllis vulneraria var. dillenii, commonly known as Kidney Vetch or Red Clover, is a flowering plant species in the legume family (Fabaceae). It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to support urinary health and to alleviate symptoms of urinary tract infections due to its diuretic and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Kidney Vetch include its ability to act as a diuretic, to reduce inflammation, and to exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Kidney Vetch include isoflavones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
